refnamediv.refpurpose: Insert a copy of a node into the child list of another node

refsynopsisdiv.programlisting: bool SilikoNodeInsertCopy( SilikoNode *object, size_t position, const SilikoNode *new_child);

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoNodeInsertCopy function copies new_child, then inserts the copy into the child list of object at position. SilikoNodeInsertCopy will fail if object is not a branch node, if new_child is NULL or if position is past the end of the child list. The calling context retains ownership of new_child and is still responsible for passing it to SilikoNodeDestroy.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoNodeInsertCopy returns true if it succeeded, or false if it failed.
